create_BLEWindField: create a BLEWindField dataset builder instance using tfds.builder_cls('ble_wind_field')
build_BLEWindFieldConfig: build a BLEWindFieldConfig with name 'full' or 'small' and optional num_fields parameter
test_BLEWindField_info: test the BLEWindField builder _info method to return dataset metadata with FeaturesDict and Tensor shape (21, 21, 10, 9, 2)
run_BLEWindField_splits: run the BLEWindField builder _split_generators method to return the train split from historical wind field zarr data
summarize_BLEWindField_examples: summarize the BLEWindField builder _generate_examples method that yields field tensors from a zarr array with concurrent chunk loading
